name: Reese's Sodium Options
summary: Replaces Sodium's video settings screen with an alternate tabbed layout that includes a search bar, collapsible groups, tooltips and per-option reset and undo buttons. It can be switched off to return to Sodium's default screen.

mechanics.title: Enable/disable
mechanics.description: The option 'Enable Reese's Sodium Options' in its General group turns the replacement off; Sodium's own screen then shows.

qol: Keyboard navigation, narration, optional Controlify controller support
Optional colour themes and option ID display
getting_started: Open Video Settings as usual; the Sodium screen appears with Reese's layout.
